title: Customer Value Delivery & Commercial Execution Control

scenarios.description: Prepared delivery may be handed off to an authorized operator without autonomous execution.
Binding commercial execution attempts are blocked during certification.
Cross-account leakage risk blocks delivery preparation.
Enterprise-scoped content may be prepared for an enterprise account.
Enterprise-scoped content must not be prepared for a public visitor.
External commercial message attempts are blocked during certification.
Internal-only content cannot be prepared for external contexts.
Invalid pricing evidence requires price review before delivery preparation.
Payment activation attempts are blocked during certification.
Premium-scoped value may be delivered to a premium subscriber.
Premium-scoped value is blocked for a public visitor.
Public value may be prepared for a public visitor.
Repeated identical evaluation remains deterministic and idempotent.
Restricted content is deterministically redacted before a simulated prepared delivery.
Unsafe security state blocks delivery preparation.
Stale product evidence blocks delivery preparation.
Unknown privacy state requires privacy review before delivery preparation.
Unknown rights evidence requires legal review before delivery preparation.
An enterprise delivery package may be simulated for enterprise portal handoff.
A valid public web delivery package may be simulated without external transmission.
